data.content:
## [Unable to track package](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6505b90b5e4cab316fd886bc)
9/21 update. I’m still awaiting a response from L+G. I emailed customer support two days ago, hoping to hear something today, but I’ve never experienced zero order updates before after an order has been placed. I thought it was Shop, but I think it’s L+G. Order placed on 9/8 and since then, crickets in regards to my order. // Previous: It's Shop that I'm not a fan of. I got an email from L+G stating my order was placed, and then I was directly handed over to Shop without a tracking number. It required me to download the app, but after I downloaded it, I cannot track my package without connecting my email and authorizing Shop to literally have access to all my emails and info. Absolutely not. Further, L+G has provided no updates either and it's been 9 days since my order was placed and I have no idea when I will receive my item. When I placed the order it said 2-3 days (I anticipate that meant to ship), but I feel in the dark. My two cents!

September 7, 2023
